subject.title: fix(hooks): serialize same-session agent hook dispatch to prevent silent event loss from session-claim races

question: Which open implementation should be the canonical fix for the same-session hook claim race: this PR with supplied runtime proof, or the broader-test peer at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110134?
rationale: Both branches address the same user problem, but selecting the canonical branch and deciding which proof and test coverage to preserve is an ownership decision rather than an automated close or repair action.

options.title: Adopt this PR as the canonical branch
options.body: Keep this proof-backed implementation and incorporate any clearly useful failure-draining and cross-session tests before merge.

options.title: Adopt the peer implementation
options.body: Move review to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110134 after it supplies comparable real behavior proof, then close this branch as superseded only once that route is viable.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR as the canonical branch
recommendation.body: Keep this proof-backed implementation and incorporate any clearly useful failure-draining and cross-session tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They reported the linked bug and authored the independent implementation that creates the concrete canonicalization choice.
